title: Between vulnerability and resilience: A network analysis of fluctuations in cognitive risk and protective factors following remission from depression
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subjects network
limitations: - ESM procedures are limited in terms of the amount of variables that can be repeatedly assessed; - Subjective resilience ratings may overlap with other constructs; - Data are limited in time and do not provide diagnostic information.
notes: The paper was pre-registered on OSF (osf.io/g2k4w). The code and data are available upon request.
